mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id, u.nickname, w.total_asset, ((w.total_asset - 10000000) * 100.0 / 10000000) AS return_rate, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY w.total_asset DESC) AS `rank` FROM wallet w INNER JOIN users u ON w.user_id = u.user_id ORDER BY w.total_asset DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT user_id, nickname, total_asset, return_rate, `rank` FROM ( SELECT u.user_id, u.nickname, w.total_asset, ((w.total_asset - 10000000) * 100.0 / 10000000) AS return_rate, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY w.total_asset DESC) AS `rank` FROM wallet w INNER JOIN users u ON w.user_id = u.user_id ) AS ranked WHERE user_id = #{userId}
